seo.description: Sample project: irrigation repair for a Langford retail centre's parking islands, scheduled before store hours, with a written record of fixes. Free quote.

summary: Leak and coverage repairs across parking-island planters.
story: The property manager saw water running across the lot on watering mornings.
We traced the leaks to a failed valve and damaged drip lines, worked before store hours and sent a written record of each repair.
Read more about [irrigation](/services/irrigation/), see our work in [Langford](/areas/langford/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
result: Leaks fixed, with a record of what was replaced.
